# Automating DNA

> Automating DNA is a Florida software company that builds SaaS products
> and B2B automations for service businesses. Its flagship product is InspectAI,
> AI photo estimate software for contractors.

## Pages
- [Home](https://automatingdna.com/): company overview, flagship product, what we build
- [Products](https://automatingdna.com/products.html): InspectAI details, client-build-to-product pipeline
- [What We Build](https://automatingdna.com/services.html): estimating and intake automation, follow-up and pipeline systems, scheduling and payments, custom builds
- [About](https://automatingdna.com/about.html): Automating DNA, founded 2025, Florida
- [Contact](https://automatingdna.com/contact.html): contact form and info@automatingdna.com
- [Privacy Policy](https://automatingdna.com/privacy-policy.html)
- [Terms of Service](https://automatingdna.com/terms-of-service.html)

## Products
- InspectAI: photo estimate software for contractors (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, painting, auto body, landscaping, pest control, garage door). Customer sends photos; software drafts a conditional estimate from the business's own pricing; the business reviews and approves; the customer books and pays from one link. Free plan available, no credit card. https://goinspectai.com
